title: Founded with focus
description: Established in Gurugram by three engineers with a clear objective: deliver HVAC systems with precision and integrity.

title: Growing reach
description: Expanded beyond NCR, building trust for HVAC work across India and strengthening delivery capability.

title: Industry recognition
description: Earned credibility with major power and industrial clients, including partnerships with leading national and global engineering teams.

title: Vertical integration
description: Brought AHU and air washer manufacturing in-house to improve performance, quality control and project certainty.

title: A national stage
description: Supported stadium and hospitality HVAC works for the 2010 Commonwealth Games in Delhi, demonstrating large-scale execution under pressure.

title: MEPF expansion
description: Extended from specialist HVAC into a broader MEPF capability, creating the integrated delivery model used today.

title: Airport scale
description: Delivered major MEPF works for Mopa International Airport, marking a significant step into large infrastructure execution.

title: Critical continuity
description: Maintained essential HVAC operations across NCR hospitals and healthcare facilities, ensuring uninterrupted service during the pandemic.

title: Data centre entry
description: Entered the data centre sector with mission-critical projects, bringing uptime-first engineering to a new vertical.

title: Semiconductor growth
description: Expanded into semiconductor infrastructure, delivering cleanroom and support systems for advanced electronics manufacturing.
